In the farmer's barn

He wanted the Cock to become his new friend

Another Cock
A wise Owl

Never leave the safety of the farmyard to travel in the woods

Move the whole family to a new house
Build a trap and catch the Cat in it
Ask the Dog to chase the Cat far away

questions.q: In 'Belling the Cat', what did the old Mouse's question show?

A bell would be much too heavy for any mouse to carry
The Cat was really friendly and no one needed to fear her
questions.evidence: It is one thing to say that something should be done, but quite a different matter to do it.
